$comment: version 2.0.0 — per-origin removal: code enum trimmed from eight values to seven (per-origin allowlisting gone).
title: Embedded Auth — postMessage error envelope (v1)
description: Wire shape posted by the embed-auth popup back to its opener via `window.opener.postMessage(envelope, requestedOrigin)` when the auth flow fails. The seven error codes are stable and machine-readable. `agent` is populated only for per-agent failures (`AGENT_ARCHIVED`, `AGENT_DISABLED`, `AGENT_KILLED`); other codes MUST omit `agent` to avoid leaking existence information. v1 envelopes are intentionally exact (`additionalProperties: false`).

state.description: Cryptographically random nonce echoed from the popup request, so the widget can correlate the error with its in-flight request.

message.description: Human-readable error message; not localized in v1.

agent.description: Bare agent name (matching `agent.agentName`) when the error is per-agent (`AGENT_ARCHIVED`, `AGENT_DISABLED`, `AGENT_KILLED`). Omitted otherwise.
